name: BANK-03 monthly configured-day retention restart verification

tests.name: Reauthenticate ordinary order owner after serving-server restart
Read the persisted monthly standing order as its owner
Assert settlement, occurrence idempotency, ledger receipts and original day after restart

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN b.month_day=31 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM b.next_run_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')=31 AND b.next_run_at>b.last_occurrence_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_order_occurrences o WHERE o.bank_orders_id=b.bank_orders_id AND o.outcome='paid' AND o.amount=1),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_order_occurrences o WHERE o.bank_orders_id=b.bank_orders_id AND o.outcome='paid' AND o.scheduled_for=b.last_occurrence_at AND o.amount=1),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_transactions t WHERE t.tx_group_id='bank-order-'||b.bank_orders_id||'-'||EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM b.last_occurrence_at)::bigint AND t.amount=1) FROM bank_orders b WHERE b.player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank_monthly_qa');
